question: Can the toy obstruction transfer by a wordwise additive embedding or quotient compatible with SHA-256 Sigma0?
scope: All nontrivial proper additive subgroups H_t = 2^t Z/(2^32), t=1..31
claim_to_check: v_t belongs to H_t but Sigma0(v_t) does not
budget: 31 deterministic witnesses; no increased toy widths, no search, no SHA benchmark
interpretation: Excludes this transfer mechanism, not the existence of arbitrary full-state encodings or common updates for 32-bit SHA
